candidate_name: Pivdennyi (Yuzhny) FSRU / Odesa LNG terminal revival
sponsor_or_proposer: Reported: Excelerate Energy + a Spanish gas company (Nov 2024); broader Ukraine govt / D.Trading; US energy companies (Zelenskyy White House pitch, Oct 2025)
current_state: Recurring revival discussion at the Yuzhnyi/Pivdennyi (Odesa Oblast) port — site of GEM's existing cancelled 'Ukraine LNG Terminal'. Variously described as an FSRU (~5 bcm/y, possible 2026) and a two-phase FSRU-then-onshore ~15 bcm/y terminal. As of Oct 2025, the latest iteration is reported as effectively cancelled/stalled: no FID, no financing, and contingent on a Turkey/Bosphorus transit agreement for LNG carriers.
missing_threshold_elements: No confirmed FID; no firm sponsor+charter combination corroborated by a primary source; Bosphorus access for LNG carriers unresolved; wartime risk. Overlaps an existing (cancelled) GEM record, so any addition should be a revival decision, not a new terminal.
watch_for: A primary-source FSRU charter/EPC award; a signed Excelerate (or other) deployment to Pivdennyi; Turkey/Bosphorus transit agreement; an FID announcement by Naftogaz/D.Trading or the Ukrainian government.
notes: Tie to existing GEM terminal T100000130561 (Ukraine LNG Terminal, OtherNames: Black Sea LNG, Odessa LNG). The original Excelerate-Yuzhny engineering agreement dates to April 2013; current activity is a revival of the same concept. Treat as revive-or-supersede the cancelled record rather than a fresh discovery.
